case_id.description: Identifier matching case catalogue (e.g. P01, C01, B01, W01)

source_revision.description: Git commit SHA or release tag under test

host_class.description: Hardware and OS environment of execution

model_runtime_digest.description: Pinned digest of Gemma 4 E4B (e.g. gemma4:e4b-it-q4_K_M sha256:...)

expected_observation.description: Defined expected output, state, or gate action

actual_observation.description: Actual observation recorded. Must NEVER contain unredacted secrets or private keys.

safe_evidence_ref.description: Pointer to sanitized event ID, receipt ID, or test report

limitations.description: Honest limitation note or scope boundary observed
